d: A toon character named Glidy used in the opening of a Japanese TV show from the 70s that was sort of like Charlie's Angels. There was apparently lots of softcore stuff in the series, because it's basically a classic live action series about fanservice and surprisingly serious detective work. But damn, did they create a great furry toon for the opening! She deserved her own anime! I don't know if she's a cat or a fox. No official info I can find can give a definitive answer. But if the fanart is any indication, she's likely a cat. She's got an impeccable figure. Makes you wonder why Japan steered so far from furry content after the 80s. They were so good at it.
n: [Misc] The Super Girl Glidy 1979 (The Super Girl TV Series)
